突发事件: 进攻星球

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we accept this contract we'll be in for the duration of the campaign, Commander. We'll be offered a series of contracts by {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} to support their forces as they invade, and we'll take a hit to our reputation if we leave before the invasion concludes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，如果我们接受这份合同，我们就要参与整个战役。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}会提供一系列合同，支持他们入侵时的部队，而如果我们在入侵结束前离开，声望会受损。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Over the coming weeks, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} plans to launch a devastating offensive against {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, catching the defenders off guard and taking the planet before they can properly mobilize. They've put out a discreet call for mercenary commands like ours to supplement their forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在未来几周内，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}计划对{TGT_SYSTEM.name}发动一场毁灭性攻势，在守军猝不及防之际夺下这颗行星。他们已发出低调的号召，招募像我们这样的雇佣兵部队来补充兵力。
